sections.title: The landscape company that *cares about the community*

image.alt: A member of the Verdant team

body: Verdant Landscape, formerly known as Dalzell Design Landscaping, has the vision, technology and skilled landscape design professionals to bring your outdoor plans to life. From plantings and gardens to hardscapes and pool installations, we design, plan and build.
With more than 17 years of operating and growing in the CSRA, we are dedicated to our craft and to the region's natural ecosystem, with sustainable landscaping practices.

items.text: Verdant Landscape is an exceptional company that provides quality work and great service. They did a large stamped concrete patio and a beautiful customized fireplace for my backyard. From start to finish they were wonderful.
